name: What is the difference between a general contractor and a project coordinator?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a general contractor and a project coordinator?

acceptedAnswer.text: While a general contractor typically includes project coordination as a core service, a standalone project coordinator might be hired for oversight if you are managing subcontractors yourself. A general contractor, like Simply Construction, assumes overall responsibility for the entire project, including hiring and managing all trades, ensuring quality, and handling legal compliance. A project coordinator primarily focuses on scheduling, communication, and logistical flow, but may not hold the same legal or financial responsibility as a general contractor.
acceptedAnswer.description: A general contractor manages all aspects of a remodel, including coordination, while a project coordinator primarily handles scheduling and logistics.
